propositions: Current review_interrupts metric is published as a single dimensionless rollup, making it impossible for CloudWatch-only sweeps to distinguish between bound-exceeded (drain check working, bot busy) and signal-unavailable (probe broken, deploys running blind) causes

Two new dimensionless metrics review_interrupts_bound_exceeded and review_interrupts_signal_unavailable are emitted alongside the unchanged rolled-up total by splitting observability.sh journal patterns via existing publish_autodeploy_marker_delta helper with new offset files

Two reason-scoped alarms rebar-autodeploy-review-interrupts-bound-exceeded and rebar-autodeploy-review-interrupts-signal-unavailable replace the single alarm, each carrying only its own remediation and preserving the 900s/1-datapoint/Sum>0 cadence

Automated test test_observability_interrupt_reasons.py verifies the split behavior against real observability.sh with synthetic journal, including the piranha case where all firings are bound-exceeded
Terraform apply must be executed by an operator to activate the alarm changes on live infrastructure; metrics publish automatically after code deployment but alarms remain unchanged until apply
